title: Per-document SyncStatus is derived from mailbox depth, not from a stored flag
content:
`SyncStatus` is not a field the reactor writes and updates. It is **computed on demand from the depth of the channel's mailboxes**, which is why it can never drift out of step with the actual queues.

```typescript
getSyncStatus(documentId: string): SyncStatus | undefined;
onSyncStatusChange(callback: SyncStatusChangeCallback): () => void;
```

```typescript
enum SyncStatus {
  Synced = "SYNCED",
  Outgoing = "OUTGOING",
  Incoming = "INCOMING",
  OutgoingAndIncoming = "OUTGOING_AND_INCOMING",
  Error = "ERROR",
}
```

The derivation rules are strictly ordered: **any error gives `Error`**; pending work in both directions gives `OutgoingAndIncoming`; otherwise it is `Incoming`, `Outgoing`, or — with both mailboxes empty — `Synced`. Because error wins, `Error` does not tell you the direction failed in; read the dead-letter events or the per-remote connection state for that.

`getSyncStatus` returns `undefined` for a document that has never been tracked. That is a distinct third state from "synced" and worth handling explicitly in UI: absent, not clean. `onSyncStatusChange` returns an unsubscribe function, and its callback is `(documentId: string, status: SyncStatus) => void`.

This per-document view is one of three. The other two are per-job (`waitForSync(jobId)`, which resolves — never rejects — on both success and failure, carrying `status: "succeeded" | "failed"`) and per-remote (`channel.getConnectionState()`, returning a `ConnectionStateSnapshot` with `state`, `failureCount`, `pushBlocked`, `receivingPages`, and `requiresAuth`).

There is a hard boundary to be aware of: when the sync manager runs in a SharedWorker and you hold the tab-side RPC proxy, `waitForSync` **always** rejects with `"waitForSync is not supported over the worker RPC boundary"`. In that topology the mailbox-derived `getSyncStatus` / `onSyncStatusChange` pair and per-remote connection state are your only observability, which makes this derived status the more portable of the three views.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/01-Reactor/04-Synchronization.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: Synced/Outgoing/Incoming/OutgoingAndIncoming/Error. Any error wins; pending in both directions gives OutgoingAndIncoming. Untracked documents return undefined.
